# Conformance vectors from OpenSSL 3.5.7, an implementation this
# package shares no code with. Each line is
#   scheme|public key hex|secret key hex|SHA-256 of signature
# where the signature is OpenSSL's, in its deterministic mode,
# over the message 01 02 ... 20 with the context string release.
#
# The test re-signs with the recorded secret key and compares
# the digest, so it asserts BYTE equality with OpenSSL rather
# than mere verifiability. That distinction matters: this
# implementation once matched the pq-crystals and sphincsplus
# reference code byte for byte while disagreeing with the
# standards, and a scheme that verifies only its own output
# still rejects every tampering.
#
# Regenerate only against another FIPS 204 / FIPS 205
# implementation -- never from this package, which would make
# the test assert only that it agrees with itself.
